Job Title: Workforce Operations Coordinator
Company: Northstar Contact Solutions
Location: St. Louis, MO

Responsibilities
- Coordinate daily contact-center shift schedules in NICE IEX and build weekly reports in Power BI.
- Excel in a fast-paced team environment with a high degree of ownership and 360-degree visibility.
- Manage warehouse inventory clearance logs and medical clearance forms.

Required Qualifications
- 2+ years of workforce management experience.
- Hands-on experience with NICE IEX and Power BI.
- No SQL experience required and Python is not required for this role.
- No college degree required.
- No security clearance is required.

Job Title: Senior Workforce Planning Analyst
Company: Federal Support Ops
Location: Remote - US

About the Role
For over 20 years, we have delivered customer operations. Must be at least 18 years of age. While listed as Remote, candidates must reside within 30 miles of our Arlington office and work in-office 3 days per week.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Business or Analytics, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- 2-8 years of workforce management and Demand Forecasting experience.
- Hands-on proficiency in SQL and Erlang C.
- Ability to obtain a Public Trust security clearance if required by client contract.
